titulo: Cardputer ADV as an RF multi-tool: CC1101 + nRF24L01+
resumo: An M5Stack Cardputer ADV with a hand-made perfboard hat becomes an RF research bench: CC1101 for sub-GHz (433/868/915 MHz) and nRF24L01+ PA/LNA for 2.4 GHz, on a shared SPI bus switched in software, running Bruce firmware.
Enumeration and common privesc vectors on Windows via CMD and PowerShell: services, ACLs, scheduled tasks, DLL hijacking and hash dumping.
Manual enumeration and exploitation of common Linux vectors: SUID, cron jobs, capabilities, exposed config files and post-exploitation.

titulo: Bypassing AppLocker and Constrained Language Mode
resumo: A workstation with AppLocker and PowerShell in Constrained Language Mode. From the blocked New-Object to the wrapper idea via System.Management.Automation.dll to regain Full Language and load PowerView in memory.

titulo: Active Directory: from enumeration to Domain Admin
resumo: Full lab AD chain — enumeration, credential attacks, lateral movement and escalation — with the corresponding defensive telemetry. In writing.
